note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I’m missing the actual content. The message currently shows placeholders:

- Transcript: {transcript}
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): {ddx}

Please provide:
- The full clinical transcript (doctor-patient dialogue) or paste the text.
- The DDx in JSON format (as provided by the diagnostic agent).

Once I have those, I will produce a structured SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration, history, PMH, meds, allergies, social history.
- Objective: physical findings, vitals, exam details, investigations (if any).
- Assessment & Plan: for each issue, including: likely diagnosis, consistent DDx (with likelihood tags if available), planned investigations, treatment, and referrals as applicable.
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”), and transcript quality comments if relevant.

Tips:
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- Use American English, concise, professional tone.
- Follow the exact structure with headings: Subjective, Objective, Assessment & Plan (with numbered issues), and a final Quality Checks section.
